Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The intentional bug is a memory leak caused by not cleaning up the ThreadLocal variable when it is no longer used. This is fixed by calling the remove() method on the ThreadLocal variable in the unload() method.
